category: Input Cost Assistance / Paddy Procurement Support
description: A flagship state scheme providing input assistance and price support to paddy farmers in Chhattisgarh, ensuring remunerative returns and enhancing agricultural productivity.
benefits: Financial assistance through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) calculated per acre to cover differential paddy input costs, guaranteeing substantial income payout per quintal.
eligibility: Farmers registered on the CG Unified Farmer Portal (Kisan Portal).
Cultivators (owners and registered tenant farmers) selling paddy through Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS).

scheme_name: Deendayal Upadhyay Bhoomihin Krishi Majdoor Kalyan Yojana
description: Provides direct cash assistance to landless agricultural labourer families, rural artisans, and traditional priests in Scheduled areas across Chhattisgarh to support their living standards.
benefits: Annual cash benefit of ₹10,000 paid directly to the bank account in installments.
eligibility: Domicile of Chhattisgarh.
Rural landless families dependent primarily on agricultural labor.
Traditional priests (Baiga, Gunia, Manjhi, Haat Pahariya) in tribal areas without landholding.
documents: Landless Declaration Certificate verified by Tehsildar/Gram Panchayat
application_mode: Online / Offline via Gram Panchayat or Revenue Portal

description: Implemented by CREDA under the Energy Department, providing highly subsidized solar-powered water pumping systems to farmers for reliable irrigation in non-electrified off-grid agricultural zones.
benefits: Subsidized 3 HP and 5 HP solar pumps provided at a nominal fraction (5% to 10%) of the total equipment cost.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers of Chhattisgarh with agricultural land.
Fields located in areas lacking regular electrical grid connections.
Assured ground/surface water source.
application_mode: Offline via CREDA District Offices / Agriculture Department

description: Provides financial subsidy to small and marginal farmers for digging open wells and installing diesel/electric/solar pump sets for crop diversification and micro-irrigation.
benefits: Up to 75% subsidy on irrigation pumps and up to 50% subsidy on open well construction cost.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers possessing up to 2 hectares of land.
Prioritization given to SC, ST, and women farmers.
application_mode: Offline via Senior Agriculture Development Officer (SADO)

scheme_name: CG Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (State Top-Up)
description: A state supplement scheme that offers additional annual financial top-ups to small and marginal farmers enrolled in PM-KISAN within Chhattisgarh.
benefits: Additional ₹6,000 per year paid in installments directly into bank accounts (bringing combined annual benefit to ₹12,000 when paired with PM-KISAN).
eligibility: Resident farmers of Chhattisgarh.
Must be an active, verified beneficiary of PM-KISAN.
Aadhaar-seeded bank account with completed e-KYC.
application_mode: Automatic inclusion for PM-KISAN verified farmers / Gram Panchayat Agri Office

scheme_name: Krishi Yantra Seva Kendra (Farm Machinery Banks)
description: Incentivizes rural youth and agricultural cooperatives to set up Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs) to rent out heavy farm machinery (tractors, harvesters, rotavators) at affordable rates to smallholders.
benefits: Capital subsidy of up to 40% (max ₹10 lakh to ₹25 lakh depending on unit capacity) on machinery unit establishment.
eligibility: Rural youth, self-help groups (SHGs), Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), or individual farmers in Chhattisgarh.
Age between 18 and 45 years for individual entrepreneurs.
application_mode: Online via Agriculture Engineering Portal / SADO Office

scheme_name: Jaivik Kheti Mission (Organic Farming Mission Chhattisgarh)
description: Promotes 100% organic farming practices in designated tribal districts (such as Dantewada, Sukma, Bijapur, Bastar, Surguja) to reduce synthetic chemical dependency.
benefits: Distribution of free organic seed kits, bio-fertilizers, vermicompost units support, and free Organic Certification under Participatory Guarantee System (PGS).
eligibility: Farmers operating in notified organic districts/blocks of Chhattisgarh.
Individual or cluster farmer groups committing to 3-year organic conversion.
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture / Agriculture Office

description: Provides financial aid for borewell drilling and installation of energised pumps in areas with viable groundwater, increasing double-cropped acreage.
benefits: Subsidy ranging from ₹25,000 to ₹43,000 based on farmer category (General, OBC, SC/ST) for tube well drilling and pump installation.
eligibility: All landholding farmers in Chhattisgarh.
Priority given to SC/ST and small/marginal farmers with no prior tube well subsidy.
application_mode: Offline via Office of Senior Agricultural Development Officer

scheme_name: Dr. Khoobchand Baghel Krishak Ratna Award & Incentives
description: An annual state award and incentive program honoring innovative farmers in Chhattisgarh who demonstrate breakthrough techniques in crop yield, water conservation, and integrated farming.
benefits: State-level recognition certificate along with a cash award of ₹1,00,000.
eligibility: Individual progressive farmers of Chhattisgarh.
Demonstrated record of adopting innovative, sustainable, or high-yield agricultural practices.
documents: Detailed report of agricultural innovation/yield statistics
application_mode: Offline nomination through District Agriculture Officer

description: Focuses on boosting milk production across Chhattisgarh by supporting dairy unit setup, indigenous cow breed conservation, and fodder cultivation.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on purchasing 2 to 10 high-yielding milch cows/buffaloes, construction of modern cattle sheds, and chaff cutter purchases.
eligibility: Individual farmers, rural women, and dairy cooperatives in Chhattisgarh.
Must possess land/space for cattle shelter and fodder growth.
application_mode: Offline via Veterinary Assistant Surgeon / District Animal Husbandry Office
